title: Complete Two Level Metrology Workbench
description: One complete static professional metrology-themed inspection workbench scene. The entire original open worktable stands on one scene-only floor. A separate scene-only raised rectangular surface plate on the rear tabletop supports the complete unchanged height gauge on the left and complete unchanged articulated dial-probe stand on the right, leaving a clear central inspection-looking area between their whole envelopes. The complete original four-jaw caliper lies on the lower front strip of the original tabletop, rotated by one exact signed-axis quarter turn. All four whole source assets preserve their full GLB buffer payloads, complete internal node hierarchy, oriented geometry, normals and full PBR dictionaries; no component is deleted or resized. This two-level rear instrument zone and lower front hand-tool strip differ from a side-by-side printer/computer bench or floor-mounted steam piston maintenance corner. One scene zero new independent models; the plate and floor are only scene support geometry. Static visual composition only: no workpiece, calibrated datum, measurement, reading, probe contact, magnetic holding, machine process, ergonomics, load, stability, installation or safety certification. No animation, rigging or interaction was made or claimed.
